name: apprenti.dev Software Architecture & System Design Apprenticeship
audience: Mid-level to senior engineers moving into architecture-level responsibility; assumes strong implementation skills already
philosophy: Evidence-driven apprenticeship: decide, justify, defend, revise.
aiPrinciples: AI assistance must be disclosed when materially used.
AI may explain, hint, quiz and coach rehearsal for a defense; it does not generate the trade-off decision or the ADR text a task asks the apprentice to produce.
The apprentice remains accountable for every trade-off claimed and every number in a capacity, latency or SLO model.
Mentor approval is based on the apprentice's ability to defend a decision under a changed constraint, not on the polish of the document.
